# Forage Sweden

> A free guide to wild food in Sweden: which wild plants are in season in each region and month, how to recognise and harvest them, the dangerous lookalikes to avoid, and 14 dishes to cook with them.

Seasons and ranges are approximate. Every plant should be confirmed with an experienced local forager before eating.

- [App](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/se/): pick a region and month to see what is wild near you
- [All wild plants](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/se/plants/)
- [All dishes](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/se/dishes/)

## Wild plants

- [Stinging nettle](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/se/plants/nettle/): Urtica dioica; Brännässla. In season April to July.
- [Wild garlic](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/se/plants/wildgarlic/): Allium ursinum; Ramslök. In season April to June.
- [Dandelion](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/se/plants/dandelion/): Taraxacum officinale; Maskros. In season April to September.
- [Ground elder](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/se/plants/groundelder/): Aegopodium podagraria; Kirskål. In season May to July.
- [Chickweed](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/se/plants/chickweed/): Stellaria media; Våtarv. In season May to September.
- [Common sorrel](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/se/plants/sorrel/): Rumex acetosa; Ängssyra. In season May to August.
- [Wood sorrel](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/se/plants/woodsorrel/): Oxalis acetosella; Harsyra. In season May to September.
- [Fat hen](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/se/plants/fathen/): Chenopodium album; Svinmålla. In season June to September.
- [Spruce tips](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/se/plants/spruce/): Picea abies; Granskott. In season May to June.
- [Sea beet](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/se/plants/seabeet/): Beta vulgaris subsp. maritima; Strandbeta. In season May to September.
- [Sugar kelp](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/se/plants/kelp/): Saccharina latissima; Sockertång. In season March to June.
- [Blue mussels](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/se/plants/mussel/): Mytilus edulis; Blåmussla. In season January to December.
- [Sweet woodruff](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/se/plants/woodruff/): Galium odoratum; Myskmadra. In season May to June.
- [Wild raspberry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/se/plants/raspberry/): Rubus idaeus; Hallon. In season July to August.
- [Bilberry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/se/plants/bilberry/): Vaccinium myrtillus; Blåbär. In season July to September.
- [Lingonberry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/se/plants/lingonberry/): Vaccinium vitis-idaea; Lingon. In season August to October.
- [Cloudberry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/se/plants/cloudberry/): Rubus chamaemorus; Hjortron. In season July to August.
- [Wild strawberry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/se/plants/strawberry/): Fragaria vesca; Smultron. In season June to August.
- [Crowberry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/se/plants/crowberry/): Empetrum nigrum; Kråkbär. In season August to September.
- [Bog cranberry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/se/plants/cranberry/): Vaccinium oxycoccos; Tranbär. In season September to October.
- [Wild blackcurrant](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/se/plants/blackcurrant/): Ribes nigrum; Svarta vinbär. In season July to August.
- [Elderberry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/se/plants/elderberry/): Sambucus nigra; Fläderbär. In season August to September.
- [Elderflower](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/se/plants/elderflower/): Sambucus nigra; Fläder. In season June to July.
- [Sloe](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/se/plants/sloe/): Prunus spinosa; Slån. In season September to November.
- [Rose hips](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/se/plants/rosehip/): Rosa canina; Nypon. In season August to October.
- [Rowan berries](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/se/plants/rowan/): Sorbus aucuparia; Rönn. In season August to October.
- [Sea buckthorn](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/se/plants/seabuckthorn/): Hippophae rhamnoides; Havtorn. In season August to October.
- [Juniper berries](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/se/plants/juniper/): Juniperus communis; En. In season September to November.
- [Hazelnut](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/se/plants/hazelnut/): Corylus avellana; Hasselnöt. In season August to September.
- [Meadowsweet](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/se/plants/meadowsweet/): Filipendula ulmaria; Älggräs. In season July to August.
- [Lime blossom](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/se/plants/linden/): Tilia cordata; Lind. In season July.
- [Wild thyme](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/se/plants/thyme/): Thymus serpyllum; Backtimjan. In season June to August.
- [Yarrow](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/se/plants/yarrow/): Achillea millefolium; Rölleka. In season June to September.
- [Red clover](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/se/plants/redclover/): Trifolium pratense; Rödklöver. In season June to August.

## Dishes

- [Elderflower cordial (flädersaft)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/se/dishes/elderflower-cordial/): Flowers steeped with lemon and citric acid, then sweetened. Served at Midsummer.
- [Lingonberry drink (lingondricka)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/se/dishes/lingonberry-drink/): Lingonberry juice diluted as a tart everyday drink.
- [Sea buckthorn juice (havtornssaft)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/se/dishes/sea-buckthorn-juice/): Sour orange berries juiced and sweetened.
- [Spruce shoot syrup (granskottssirap)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/se/dishes/spruce-shoot-syrup/): Young spruce shoots cooked with sugar into a syrup for pancakes and drinks.
- [Moules with dill (blåmusslor)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/se/dishes/moules-with-dill/): West coast mussels steamed with white wine and dill.
- [Lingonberry jam (rårörda lingon)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/se/dishes/lingonberry-jam/): Lingonberries stirred raw with sugar for meatballs and black pudding.
- [Rowan jelly (rönnbärsgelé)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/se/dishes/rowan-jelly/): Rowan berries with apple, set into jelly for game.
- [Nettle soup with egg (nässelsoppa)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/se/dishes/nettle-soup-with-egg/): Spring nettle soup with halved boiled eggs, a classic.
- [Juniper and lingonberry game stew](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/se/dishes/juniper-and-lingonberry-game-stew/): Moose or deer braised with juniper, served with lingonberries.
- [Bilberry pie (blåbärspaj)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/se/dishes/bilberry-pie/): Crumble-topped pie of forest bilberries with vanilla sauce.
- [Cloudberry jam with waffles (hjortronsylt)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/se/dishes/cloudberry-jam-with-waffles/): Warm cloudberry jam over cream and waffles or ice cream.
- [Bilberry soup (blåbärssoppa)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/se/dishes/bilberry-soup/): Warm or cold bilberry soup, Vasaloppet skiers' fuel.
- [Rose hip soup (nyponsoppa)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/se/dishes/rose-hip-soup/): Sweet rose hip soup with almond biscuits and cream.
- [Wild strawberries on a straw (smultron)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/se/dishes/wild-strawberries-on-a-straw/): Wild strawberries threaded on a grass stalk, Midsummer style.
